clues.text: Walking beside its sea, Jesus called Simon and Andrew, two fishermen casting a net.
Jesus performed His first sign, turning water into wine, at a wedding in Cana in this region.
During Jesus' trial, Pilate learned He came from this region and sent Him to Herod, who ruled there.
At the empty tomb, an angel told the women that the risen Jesus was going ahead of the disciples to this place.
As a cloud hid the rising Jesus, two men in white called the watching apostles men of this place.
Isaiah foretold that this land of the nations, by Zebulun and Naphtali, would see a great light.
When Nicodemus defended Jesus, the Pharisees scoffed that no prophet comes out of this place.
